name: time-expense-narrative-compliance
description: Professional Services Cowork plugin for time entries: build a cited activity packet from engagement-scoped calendar and document activity, draft grounded time-entry narratives, map task and phase codes deterministically, check narratives against client billing guidelines, surface missing time and draft a pre-bill exception packet, and stop before submission or billing. Expenses are out of scope in this version: it does not handle expense reports, receipts or travel claims. Draft-first (nothing is sent without explicit confirmation); mailbox sources stay off unless the firm enables them; every compliance verdict and flag is rules-engine cited.
